Every diagnostic modelspec prints starts with a stable code such as `E-TYPE-012`, followed by a message, the source position and the values involved. [A shape error](../examples/shape-error.md) shows one in full, and [Read a diagnostic](../guides/read-a-diagnostic.md) explains each line.

Generated by `modelspec-docs` from the code constants each stage declares; the meaning is the declaration's doc comment. `modelspec check`, `modelspec compile`, `modelspec train`, `modelspec infer` and `modelspec inspect-device` exit `1` when they print one.

## Syntax

The parser of the M0 subset. A construct of the target language that M0 does not have yet has its own code, so the message names what is missing.

|---|---|---|
| <a id="e-syntax-001"></a>`E-SYNTAX-001` | A character no token starts with. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/syntax/mod.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/syntax/mod.rs) |
| <a id="e-syntax-002"></a>`E-SYNTAX-002` | A token the grammar does not allow at this position. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/syntax/mod.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/syntax/mod.rs) |
| <a id="e-syntax-003"></a>`E-SYNTAX-003` | The source ends inside an item. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/syntax/mod.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/syntax/mod.rs) |

## Types and shapes

The type and shape checker. Operator rules come from the operator registry ([Operators](operators.md)).

|---|---|---|
| <a id="e-type-001"></a>`E-TYPE-001` | An operator or model function called with the wrong number of arguments, or an operator call that omits a named argument the operator takes, such as `heads` of `attention`, or an `adamw` or `muon` optimizer that omits one of its six or nine named arguments. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |
| <a id="e-type-002"></a>`E-TYPE-002` | A named argument (`a = x`) to a model function or to an operator that takes no named argument of that name, a named argument given twice, or a named argument before an operand: the named arguments follow the operands. An `adamw` or `muon` argument that is unnamed, not one of its own, or given twice. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |
| <a id="e-type-003"></a>`E-TYPE-003` | `add`, `sub`, `mul` or `mse` operands of different shapes, neither of them rank 0, an `add_rows(x, b)` whose `b` is not as long as a row of `x`, a `layer_norm(x, gamma, beta)` whose `gamma` or `beta` is not as long as a row of `x`, an `attention(q, k, v, key_mask, heads = A)` whose `k` or `v` differs from `q` in shape or whose `key_mask` of shape `[B, S]` has `B * S` other than the rows of `q`, or a `cross_entropy(logits, labels, weights)` whose `labels` or `weights` is not as long as the rows of `logits`. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |

The RNG token of `dropout`, the third use of `i32`, is supplied by the compiler, never by a source value. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |
| <a id="e-type-019"></a>`E-TYPE-019` | A named operator argument whose value is not a literal of its kind, such as `heads = x` or `heads = 0` of `attention`, whose `heads` is an integer literal of at least 1, or `p = x` or `p = 0` of `dropout`, whose `p` is a float literal (DESIGN.md § 2.1), or an `adamw` or `muon` argument other than a float literal, or than an integer literal for `warmup_steps` and `ns_steps`. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |

A model function that reads no parameter is no reason to refuse. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |

| <a id="e-type-023"></a>`E-TYPE-023` | An `adamw` or `muon` argument out of range: a `weight_decay` below 0 or not finite, a `beta1` or `beta2` outside `[0, 1)` once rounded to `f32`, such as `beta1 = 1.0`, or an `eps` that is not a positive finite `f32`, such as `eps = 0.0` (DESIGN.md § 2.1). | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |

| <a id="e-type-025"></a>`E-TYPE-025` | A `muon` argument out of range: a `momentum` outside `[0, 1)` once rounded to `f32`, such as `momentum = 1.0`, or an `ns_steps` outside `[1, 10]`, such as `ns_steps = 0` or `ns_steps = 11` (DESIGN.md § 2.1, coordinator decision D67). | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |

## Training data

The data loaders of `modelspec train`, synthetic data, the dense files of `--data`, `--init` and `--eval` and the packed masked-language-model directory of `--data`, which run after a file checks and before the first step. A `--data` directory without `binding.json` is dense, and when every declaration names a batch tensor its refusal follows a line naming the directory and `binding.json`; `--eval` beside a packed `--data` is a usage error, exit 2, because `--eval` reads dense evaluation tensors.

| Code | Meaning | Declared in |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="e-data-001"></a>`E-DATA-001` | The `train` block does not declare exactly one `input` and one `target`. On a `--data` directory without `binding.json`, read as dense, under declarations that all name batch tensors, `train` prints a line naming the directory and `binding.json` before it. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |
| <a id="e-data-002"></a>`E-DATA-002` | The `target` is not of the model output type. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |
| <a id="e-data-003"></a>`E-DATA-003` | A declared `input` or `target` is not read by the loss. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |
| <a id="e-data-004"></a>`E-DATA-004` | A declared `input` or `target` is `i32`: synthetic data draws `f32` values and dense files hold `f32`, so neither can supply row ids. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |
| <a id="e-data-005"></a>`E-DATA-005` | A declared `input` or `target` of a run on a packed `--data` directory names no tensor of the masked-language-model batch (`ids`, `positions`, `key_mask`, `labels`, `weights`), or the `train` block of such a run declares none. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |
| <a id="e-data-006"></a>`E-DATA-006` | A declared `input` or `target` of a run on a packed `--data` directory is not of the type of its batch tensor: `i32` for `ids`, `positions` and `labels`, `f32` for `key_mask` and `weights`, of shape `[B, S]` or `[B·S]` with `S` the packed sequence length and one `B` for every declaration; or, once the packed files are read, the table of an `embedding` that reads the bound `ids` has other rows, or the logits of a `cross_entropy` that reads the bound `labels` other classes, than the packed `vocabulary_size`. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |
| <a id="e-data-007"></a>`E-DATA-007` | A data, order or `--init` file is missing, unreadable, or not a whole number of samples (for `--init`, not the parameter's size), or a data or `--init` file holds a NaN or an infinity, or the data files differ in sample count, or the `input` and `target` do not share a leading batch dimension `B`, or the `--init` directory cannot be read or holds no parameter's file. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |
| <a id="e-data-008"></a>`E-DATA-008` | `order.u32` holds fewer than `steps · B` indices, or an index not below the sample count. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |
| <a id="e-data-009"></a>`E-DATA-009` | The `--eval` sample count is not a multiple of the batch dimension `B`. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/data.rs) |

## Training

The CPU training loop of `modelspec train`, which checks the loss and every parameter after each step.

| Code | Meaning | Declared in |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="e-train-001"></a>`E-TRAIN-001` | The loss of a training step, or a parameter, an AdamW moment or a Muon momentum buffer after the update of a step, or the Frobenius norm a Muon update divides by, is NaN or ±inf: the run stops at the first such step and prints no final parameters. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/runner.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/runner.rs) |

## Checkpoints

The `.msckpt` reader of `modelspec train --resume` and `modelspec infer`, which checks the header, the checksum, every offset and length and the payload hash before it allocates a tensor, and matches the checkpoint against the compiled file.

| Code | Meaning | Declared in |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="e-ckpt-001"></a>`E-CKPT-001` | Not a readable checkpoint: it cannot be opened, or its magic, format version, endian marker, reserved field, checksum or manifest is wrong. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/checkpoint.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/checkpoint.rs) |
| <a id="e-ckpt-002"></a>`E-CKPT-002` | An offset, length or size outside the file or misaligned: the file is shorter than its header or than `file_size`, the manifest size runs past the end, or a tensor is misaligned, overlaps another part of the file, ends past it, or is not its shape's element count times its dtype size, a byte between tensors is not zero, the file does not end at its last tensor, or the manifest has more records than a file of its size can hold. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/checkpoint.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/checkpoint.rs) |
| <a id="e-ckpt-003"></a>`E-CKPT-003` | The checkpoint does not match the compiled file: a parameter path, dtype or shape, the schema hash, or for `train --resume` the optimizer differs; the first difference is named. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/checkpoint.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/checkpoint.rs) |
| <a id="e-ckpt-004"></a>`E-CKPT-004` | The payload hash differs from the payload. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/checkpoint.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/train/checkpoint.rs) |

## Artifacts

The artifact directory reader of `modelspec compile`, which checks the format version, the size of each plan as the manifest is parsed, that every kernel module file is present and no longer than its entry, each module hash and the artifact hash, and then the invariants and the execution plan, in that order; then, before a device runs it, that the device reports at least the workgroup limits the plan was scheduled for.

| Code | Meaning | Declared in |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="e-artifact-001"></a>`E-ARTIFACT-001` | The artifact directory cannot be read as an artifact: `artifact.json` is missing, not a regular file, unreadable, larger than `MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES` or not a manifest, or its `format_version` is not one this build reads (`FORMAT_VERSION`). | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs) |
| <a id="e-artifact-002"></a>`E-ARTIFACT-002` | A kernel module's bytes differ from the blake3 its manifest entry records, or the manifest's `artifact_hash` or `artifact_id` is not the one its content gives: the artifact was changed after it was written. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs) |
| <a id="e-artifact-003"></a>`E-ARTIFACT-003` | The artifact breaks an invariant of `spec/domains/artifact.yaml` or the plan verifier: a plan of more than 4096 steps (`MAX_PLAN_STEPS`), 65536 dependencies (`MAX_PLAN_DEPENDENCIES`) or 65536 step views (`MAX_PLAN_VIEWS`), refused as the manifest is parsed, before the module files and the hashes are checked and so whether the artifact is sealed or not; or, in a sealed artifact, a byte size that does not fit in 64 bits, a buffer larger than 4294967295 bytes, a kernel module that is not SPIR-V (whole little-endian words, a 5-word header, the magic number 0x07230203), a Dispatch naming a module the artifact does not own, a dependency on a step that is not before it, a view outside its buffer, or any other execution-plan rule. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs) |
| <a id="e-artifact-004"></a>`E-ARTIFACT-004` | A kernel module file the manifest names is missing, not a regular file (a link, a device or a FIFO), cannot be read, or is longer than the byte length its entry records, or `kernels/` holds an entry no kernel of the manifest names; every file is checked before any module is hashed, and no read goes past the entry's byte length. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs) |
| <a id="e-artifact-005"></a>`E-ARTIFACT-005` | The device reports fewer invocations per workgroup or fewer bytes of workgroup memory than the `matmul_limits` the artifact's plan was scheduled for (`check_device`): the plan's tiles may not fit it, so it is refused before any module is built or dispatched. The diagnostic names the recorded and the reported value of both limits. A device profile given to a compile (`compile --device-profile`, `train --backend vulkan`) that reports fewer than 128 invocations or 16384 bytes of workgroup memory, the Vulkan minimum the smallest matmul tile needs (`MatMulLimits::checked`), is refused with this code before a plan is scheduled, naming the field, its bound and the reported value. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/artifact.rs) |

## Target

Backend selection of `modelspec train` and `modelspec infer`, before the file is read, Vulkan device discovery and negotiation of `modelspec inspect-device`, `modelspec train --backend vulkan` and `modelspec infer --backend vulkan`, and the limits of the Vulkan target the schedule checks.

| Code | Meaning | Declared in |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="e-target-001"></a>`E-TARGET-001` | The selected backend is not available: `--backend vulkan` of `train` or `infer` in a build without the `vulkan` feature. | [`crates/modelspec-cli/src/train.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-cli/src/train.rs) |
| <a id="e-target-002"></a>`E-TARGET-002` | No Vulkan loader could be opened: the library `MODELSPEC_VULKAN_LIBRARY` names, or the system's `libvulkan`, is missing or is not a Vulkan loader. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/vulkan/mod.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/vulkan/mod.rs) |
| <a id="e-target-003"></a>`E-TARGET-003` | No Vulkan physical device was found, the device index names none of them, or the chosen device has no compute queue family. | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/vulkan/select.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/vulkan/select.rs) |
| <a id="e-target-004"></a>`E-TARGET-004` | The Vulkan device is below the Vulkan API version the runtime requires (1.2.0). | [`crates/modelspec-runtime/src/vulkan/negotiate.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-runtime/src/vulkan/negotiate.rs) |
| <a id="e-target-010"></a>`E-TARGET-010` | A tensor of the training step is too large for the Vulkan target of M1: one dispatch over it needs more than 65,535 workgroups in each of three dimensions or more than 2^32 invocations, its buffer holds more than 4,294,967,295 bytes (the `u32` range of a storage buffer binding), or its byte count does not fit in 64 bits (DESIGN.md § 8.1). The file checks; reduce the shape. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/compile.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/compile.rs) |
| <a id="e-target-011"></a>`E-TARGET-011` | An operator of the training step has no Vulkan kernel yet, or the optimizer `muon`, whose step runs on the CPU interpreter only and is reported at the `train` block; and, refused by `infer --backend vulkan` rather than the schedule, `dropout`, whose inference runs the step plan with its dropouts (DESIGN.md § 8.1). The file checks; use `--backend cpu`. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/compile.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/compile.rs) |

## Compiler bugs

Internal codes. No source file is meant to reach them; one that does is a bug to report, not a mistake in the model.

| Code | Meaning | Declared in |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="e-internal-001"></a>`E-INTERNAL-001` | A compiler verification failure, not a user error (DESIGN.md § 8.1): the checker reached a state its own rules exclude, such as a registry dtype mismatch between two operands that each passed their own dtype check. Not in `ALL`; no source file is meant to reach it. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/types.rs) |
| <a id="e-internal-002"></a>`E-INTERNAL-002` | A compiler verification failure in the tensor or training pipeline, not a user error (DESIGN.md § 8.1): lowering refused checked HIR, the program its passes produced does not verify, or autodiff, optimizer attachment or the step's verification refused verified Tensor IR. No source file is meant to reach it. | [`crates/modelspec-core/src/compile.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-core/src/compile.rs) |
